purpose: Collect structured support requests without collecting secrets or credentials.

fields.label: Website URL
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible optional label with URL validation.

fields.label: Description
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label with guidance not to include passwords or secrets.

fields.label: Screenshot Upload
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label; allowed file types listed.

fields.label: Privacy Acknowledgement
fields.accessibility_notes: Clear consent label and support data note.

confirmations.name: Default
confirmations.message: Thanks. Your request has been received and will be reviewed by the support team.

notifications.name: Support team notification
notifications.message: Include summary, issue type, urgency, and entry link. Do not attach uploads unless approved.

feeds.name: Optional support desk feed
feeds.addon: Help Scout, Slack, Zapier, or Webhooks if installed
feeds.condition: Only after connector and privacy review.

spam_settings.turnstile: consider for public support forms if add-on and keys are confirmed

data_retention_notes: Support entries may contain personal or sensitive operational data; define retention, access, and upload handling before launch. Consent record and wording must be reviewed for retention, export, and erase handling.

test_data.Name: Test Customer
test_data.Description: This is a test support request.

risks: File uploads may contain sensitive data.
Do not collect passwords, API keys, licence keys, tokens, or payment details.
